title: Sign up with email and password
summary: Auth page signup mode creates a Supabase auth user; on success the zustand store sets user and session and the page redirects to /dashboard.
notes: If Supabase returns no session (email confirmation enabled, UNKNOWN), store still sets user, redirect happens, and every API call then fails with User not authenticated.
preconditions: Valid email, password min 6 chars, form not submitting
downstream: Auth.tsx Navigate to /dashboard; all services read session access_token

title: Sign in with email and password
summary: Login mode of the auth page calls signInWithPassword; success sets user and session and redirects to /dashboard, failure shows the Supabase error message in an alert.
notes: No password reset, magic link, OAuth or email verification UI exists in slice.
downstream: ProtectedRoute and services now see user and token

title: Toggle login and signup mode
summary: Link button on the auth form switches between Sign In and Create Account and clears any error.
notes: Mode is React state in Auth.tsx, lost on reload.
downstream: Chooses signIn or signUp on submit

title: Sign out
summary: Sign Out in the global sidebar (shown only when a user exists) calls supabase signOut, clears store user and session, and navigates to /auth.
notes: React Query cache and project_* localStorage keys (stage, sceneId, reachedPhaseB) are not cleared on sign out.
downstream: ProtectedRoute redirects to /auth on protected pages

title: Auto-redirect logged-in users from root and auth
summary: Visiting / or /auth while authenticated redirects to /dashboard; unauthenticated visitors see the landing page at /.
notes: /landing always renders the landing page regardless of auth.

title: Route protection for authenticated pages
summary: ProtectedRoute wraps /dashboard, /projects/:projectId, /style-capsules and /assets; unauthenticated users are redirected to /auth without a usable return path.
notes: Redirect state.from is set but nothing reads location.state, so post-login always goes to /dashboard. Protection is client-side only; backend enforces auth separately.

title: Public landing page
summary: Static marketing page at / (when logged out) and /landing listing a 12-stage pipeline, capabilities, workflow and a $6.66/month pricing block.
notes: All media slots are placeholders (no src). Pricing, trial, multi-provider and git-branching claims have no backing in code or dependencies.

title: Landing theme toggle and smooth scroll
summary: Landing has its own dark/light palette toggle persisted in localStorage landing-theme and scroll-to-section buttons for Process and Pricing.
notes: Separate from the app-wide next-themes provider.

title: List projects on dashboard
summary: Dashboard loads the user's projects via GET /api/projects and renders a card grid ordered by most recent update.
notes: Each card shows branch chip from the embed; list code also computes stage and scene summaries.

title: Search projects on dashboard
summary: Search box filters loaded projects client-side by title or description substring, case-insensitive.
notes: Search is not sent to the server.

title: Inert dashboard Filter and Sort buttons
summary: Filter and Sort icon buttons on the dashboard render but have no click handler.
notes: No sort or filter behavior exists; list order is server updated_at desc.

title: Dashboard load error and retry
summary: If the project list fails, the dashboard shows the error text, a Try Again button and a destructive toast.
notes: Reachable only under API failure; runtime not exercised.

title: Create project from dashboard (title only)
summary: NewProjectCard opens a dialog asking only for a title; submit POSTs /api/projects, shows a success toast and navigates to /projects/:id.
notes: Only the service call shape is tested (projectService.test.ts createProject cases); the route is untested. Backend defaults project_type narrative, content_rating PG, target 180-300 s. The App.tsx handleNewProject TODO is not on this path.
code_path: NewProjectDialog.handleSubmit -> projectService.createProject -> POST /api/projects -> projectsRouter.post('/') -> insert projects (DB trigger creates Main branch)

title: Open project from dashboard card
summary: Clicking a project card navigates to /projects/:id, unless a delete dialog is open.

title: Delete project from dashboard card
summary: Hover trash icon opens a confirm dialog; confirm calls DELETE /api/projects/:id, toasts success and reloads the list.
notes: Dialog text warns scripts and generated content are removed. Storage object cleanup is not in route (UNKNOWN). Route untested.

title: Project card progress summary
summary: Card shows Stage N of 5 dots before production, or Narrative and Style Set with scene count and current scene status once scenes exist.
notes: Card shows 'Stage N of stages.length' where stages length is 5 from the API. Skipped stages render as pending on the server, so dots disagree with the ProjectView derivation.

title: Sidebar navigation between top-level pages
summary: Global sidebar buttons go to /dashboard (Projects), /style-capsules and /assets with active highlighting by pathname.

title: Collapse and expand sidebar
summary: Collapse button toggles the sidebar between 280px labelled and 72px icon-only; state is local and not persisted.

title: Project header back button
summary: Back arrow in the project header calls onBack if supplied, otherwise window.history.back(); in Phase B scene view it exits to the Script Hub.
notes: ProjectView is always rendered without onBack via App.tsx route, so history.back is the active path.

title: Artifact Vault, Story Timelines and New Branch buttons
summary: Three header buttons show toast info Coming soon; they do no work.
notes: Branch creation is absent in the backend; only the trigger-made Main branch exists.

title: Phase A timeline navigation
summary: Clicking a Phase A stage node navigates to it if its status is not pending (stages 1 to 5); stage clicks above 5 are allowed when already in Phase B.
notes: Connector colours follow position index, not status.

title: Restore last stage on reload
summary: Reloading a project returns to the stage in the URL query, else the stage in localStorage, then validated against stage_states hydration.
notes: Restore validation does not run when a project has zero stage_states rows, and URL Phase B stages are not validated. restoreStage() helper is unused (DEAD).
code_path: ProjectView restore effect -> hydrate effect -> navigation guard

title: Project configuration saved from Stage 1
summary: Stage 1 Proceed saves project type, rating, genres, tonal precision, length and aspect ratio via PUT /api/projects/:id, then saves a draft stage 1 row and completes stage 1.
notes: Selecting Video for Audio sends audio-visual, rejected by backend (audio_visual only), and the error is only logged. Config is the only way a project's rating, genre, length or aspect ratio changes; there is no rename or settings UI.
code_path: Stage1InputMode.handleComplete -> projectService.updateProject -> PUT /api/projects/:id; stageStateService.saveStageState(1, draft) -> PUT stages/1
data_touched: projects config columns; stage_states v+1 draft

title: Lock and advance a Phase A stage
summary: A Phase A stage's lock action calls POST /stages/:n/lock, marks it locked, activates n+1 and navigates there; stage 5 navigates to Script Hub (6).
notes: Stages 4 and 5 lock themselves before calling onComplete, so two locked versions are written. Backend lock route tested only for the predecessor check (streamlineSkip.test.ts).
preconditions: previous stage locked or skipped (backend enforced)
code_path: stage onComplete -> ProjectView.handleStageComplete -> stageStateService.lockStage -> POST /api/projects/:id/stages/:n/lock -> stageStates lock route -> insert stage_states

title: Next button on a locked Phase A stage
summary: Locked or outdated Phase A stages show a Next button that moves forward without locking.
notes: Stage 5 Next leads to stage 6.

title: Edit or Unlock and Edit a locked Phase A stage
summary: Unlock action on a locked stage calls unlockStage(confirm=false); because the 409 body is read at the wrong key the dialog never opens, and the code immediately confirms, setting the stage active and cascading locked downstream stages to outdated.
notes: Frontend tests result.downstreamStages (top level) but backend nests it under details. Outdated Phase A stage Edit returns 400 'Stage is not locked or skipped' and shows Failed to unlock stage. Confirmed by code reading only.
entrypoint: LockedStageHeader Unlock and Edit or Edit button on Phase A stages 1 to 5
preconditions: stage status locked (outdated rejected by backend)
code_path: LockedStageHeader.onUnlockAndEdit -> ProjectView.handlePhaseAUnlock -> stageStateService.unlockStage(false) -> then handleConfirmPhaseAUnlock -> unlockStage(true) -> stage_states draft version and outdated versions
downstream: stage set active; downstream outdated in local state

title: Write this myself on a skipped stage
summary: Skipped stage 2, 3 or 4 offers Write this myself, which unlocks it to draft via unlock(confirm=true), activating the stage with no content.
notes: Backend unlock also cascades locked downstream stages to outdated, which the UI comment does not mention and local state does not reflect until reload. Placeholder component tested; the handler is not.
data_touched: stage_states draft version and downstream outdated versions

title: Generate this now from script on a skipped stage
summary: For skipped stages 2 and 3 a Generate this now button backfills the stage from the locked script via the streamline backfill endpoint and marks it locked with origin ai-generated.
notes: Backfill route and service are cross-slice (streamline). Local state is set without re-fetching; whether the server write succeeded is only known via the response.
entrypoint: Skipped stage 2 or 3 Generate this now

title: Streamline commit refresh of the pipeline
summary: After a Streamline commit, the shell re-fetches stage_states, re-derives Phase A and navigates to the target stage with a success toast.
notes: Streamline commit itself is cross-slice.

title: Return to Script Hub from Phase A
summary: A Script Hub button appears on the timeline once the user has ever reached Phase B, and returns to stage 6.
notes: hasReachedPhaseB is localStorage-backed per project.

title: Enter Script Hub after Stage 5
summary: Completing Stage 5 (lock) moves the project to the Script Hub with a success toast; Script Hub lists the project's scenes.
notes: Phase B is not gated: any user can reach stage 6 by URL.

title: Enter a scene pipeline from the Script Hub
summary: Enter Scene Pipeline opens the scene at its first unlocked stage (7 to 12), reading scene stage_locks.
notes: Button disabled for deferred scenes in UI only. Lock GET route is not in the test list; only continuity routes are tested for scenes.

title: Review rendered video from Script Hub
summary: Review Video appears only when a scene's render status is complete and opens scene stage 12 directly.
notes: Render status comes from cross-slice polling.

title: Defer and restore a scene
summary: Script Hub button toggles a scene's is_deferred flag; deferred scenes are dimmed and cannot be entered from the UI.
notes: No backend route checks is_deferred; deferred scenes remain reachable by URL and by other scene routes. Routes untested.
entrypoint: Script Hub Defer Scene or Restore Scene

title: Outdated scene warning on Script Hub
summary: Clicking an outdated scene in the Script Hub opens a warning before entering.
notes: Keyed on scene.status outdated (a scene column), not on stage locks.

title: Scene workflow sidebar navigation
summary: Right-hand sidebar lists scene stages 7 to 12 (Shot List, Visuals, Prompts, Frames, Review, Video) with lock-state icons; reachable stages are enabled by sequential gating in UI.
notes: Gating is UI only; URL can open any scene stage. Missing lock key defaults to draft.
data_touched: none (local), URL not updated by sidebar

title: Scene stage complete and advance
summary: Scene stage completion calls the scene lock endpoint best-effort, marks the stage completed locally, and advances to the next scene stage; at stage 12 it toasts Scene completed and exits.
notes: Stage components already lock before calling onComplete, so the shell lock call re-stamps locked_at. A failed lock (predecessor not locked) is only logged and the UI still advances.
entrypoint: Stage component complete action for stages 7 to 12
code_path: stage onComplete -> ProjectView.handleSceneStageComplete -> sceneStageLockService.lockStage -> POST stage-locks/:n/lock

title: Scene stage Back and Next
summary: Scene stage Back goes to the previous scene stage or exits to Script Hub from stage 7; Next advances a stage.
notes: Back does not persist the new stage to URL or localStorage, so reload returns to the previously saved stage.
entrypoint: Stage component Back and Next props
data_touched: Next persists URL and localStorage; Back does not

title: Exit scene back to Script Hub
summary: Back to Scripts in the scene sidebar or the header back arrow clears the active scene and sets stage 6.
notes: Clears sceneId from URL but not from localStorage.

title: Phase B unlock with downstream impact warning (scene stages)
summary: Unlocking a locked scene stage 7 to 11 shows UnlockWarningDialog with counts of frames and videos and estimated cost, then confirms the unlock.
notes: Dialog is wired in scene stage components (Stage 7 to 11), not in the shell. Cost figures are heuristic constants in the route (0.05 per frame, 2.50 per video). Stage 12 has no unlock.
entrypoint: LockedStageHeader Unlock and Edit on scene stage
code_path: stage onUnlockAndEdit -> useSceneStageLock.unlockStage(409 impact) -> confirmUnlock -> POST stage-locks/:n/unlock confirm true

title: Re-lock an outdated scene stage
summary: Outdated scene stages 7 to 11 show a Re-lock button that locks them again without changes when the previous stage is locked.
notes: Phase A has no Re-lock control even though backend stage_states has no relock route.
preconditions: stage status outdated; previous scene stage locked

title: Status badges on Phase A timeline
summary: Timeline nodes show OUTDATED (with origin subtext), SKIPPED, IMPORTED and AUTO-FILLED badges derived from status and origin.
notes: Outdated rows created by unlock cascade have origin NULL, so subtext is usually absent. Badge test asserts precedence table.

title: Stage info popover
summary: Floating info button at bottom-right (appears after 400 ms) opens a popover with three tips for the current stage or the dashboard.
notes: Some tip copy (branches, input modes) describes features not in this slice.

title: Phase A stage read-only locked view
summary: Locked Phase A stages render a LOCKED-IN badge with Next and Unlock and Edit; outdated stages render OUTDATED with Edit and Next (no Re-lock in Phase A).
notes: Outdated Edit in Phase A always fails with 400 from backend (see CAP-26).
entrypoint: Phase A stage 1 to 5 header when locked or outdated

title: Continuity mode read and write (API)
summary: GET and PUT /api/projects/:id/continuity-mode read or set basic or advanced continuity mode stored on the project.
notes: Only Stage 8 location coverage panel invokes it (cross-slice). Route is tested.
code_path: locationContinuityService -> GET or PUT continuity-mode -> projects table

title: Continuity metrics summary (API)
summary: GET /api/projects/:id/continuity-metrics returns counts of unresolved locations, direction gaps, fallback references and reuse rate, plus strict-mode issues, optionally filtered by scene.
notes: Read-only. Suggestions are three fixed strings.
code_path: locationContinuityService -> GET continuity-metrics -> shots and frames reads

title: Style capsule library page
summary: Page at /style-capsules lists writing and visual style capsules with search, type and preset filters, favorite toggle, duplicate (presets), view or edit, delete (custom), and create dialogs.
notes: Data path is cross-slice (/api/style-capsules). Favorite filter has no UI. After reset to all, empty-state copy wrongly says try filters and hides create.

title: Asset library page
summary: Page at /assets lists global assets with search, type tabs with counts, grid or list toggle, create, edit and delete.
notes: Data path cross-slice (/api/assets). Assets are global, not project scoped.

title: Create project through Stage 1 at /projects/new
summary: Typing /projects/new renders Stage 1 with projectId new; Proceed creates a project titled from the chosen mode, saves config and draft stage 1, then the stage 1 lock call fails with 404 because it targets the literal new id.
notes: Code-level finding: handleStageComplete calls stageStateService.lockStage(projectId,1) with projectId new, backend returns 404 Project not found, error toast shows. The created project remains with draft stage 1 and URL stays on /projects/new. No link to this path exists in UI.
code_path: Stage1InputMode.handleComplete -> projectService.createProject -> updateProject -> saveStageState -> onComplete -> ProjectView.handleStageComplete(1) -> lockStage('new') 404

title: Landing Explore Stage buttons
summary: Hover Explore Stage buttons on the landing pipeline list are visual only and not focusable.

title: Not-found page
summary: Any unmatched path shows a 404 page with a Return to Home link and logs the path to console.
notes: Index.tsx NotFound-like fallback is not used.

title: Project header aspect ratio chip
summary: Header shows the project aspect ratio read-only (set in Stage 1).
notes: Default 16:9 when absent. Branch chip shows fallback main text.

title: Phase A stage save creates a new version (PUT stages/:n)
summary: Every save inserts a new stage_states version for the active branch with status defaulting to draft; a latest locked row stays locked; origin is set from the request or NULL.
notes: Style capsule application log written if styleCapsuleMetadata present; failure ignored. Route untested.
trigger: stageStateService.saveStageState / autoSave / forceSave from stage components
precondition: project owned by user, active branch exists, valid stage 1 to 12, object content
side_effects: INSERT stage_states; INSERT style_capsule_applications when metadata; UPDATE projects.updated_at
invalidates: none directly; downstream stages are not touched
preserves: latest locked status (regression guard); inherited_from_stage_id link
ui_signal: Auto-save toast on failure; Saving or All changes saved text in Stage 1

title: Phase A lock (POST stages/:n/lock)
summary: Lock inserts a new version with status locked, copying content and guidance, and origin NULL, if the previous stage is locked or skipped.
notes: Locking an already locked, outdated or skipped stage is allowed (no status check). Test covers predecessor check only.
trigger: stage lock action via ProjectView.handleStageComplete or stage component stageStateService.lockStage
precondition: latest row exists; for n greater than 1 latest n-1 locked or skipped
ui_signal: Toast Stage n completed and locked; stage timeline locked node

title: Phase A skip (POST stages/:n/skip)
summary: Stages 2, 3 and 4 can be marked skipped with empty content and origin skipped when the previous stage is locked or skipped and the current stage is not locked.
notes: Route reachable only via Streamline commit RPC path in practice; frontend skipStage wrapper has no caller.
trigger: skip request (no UI caller found in slice)
precondition: stage 2 to 4; previous locked or skipped; current not locked
side_effects: INSERT skipped row, origin skipped, content empty; bump projects.updated_at

title: Phase A unlock assessment (409, no write)
summary: Unlock with confirm false returns 409 listing downstream locked or outdated Phase A stages without writing.
notes: Frontend reads top-level downstreamStages which is absent; treats as no impact.
precondition: stage 1 to 5; latest locked or skipped (outdated or draft gives 400)

title: Phase A unlock confirm (draft plus downstream outdated)
summary: Confirmed unlock inserts draft for the stage and outdated versions for every downstream stage whose latest is locked or outdated; skipped downstream rows are untouched.
notes: Downstream outdated versions copy content with origin NULL and no status check. Frontend updates downstream locked to outdated only when local status is locked.
trigger: POST unlock {confirm:true} or skip-unlock via Write this myself
side_effects: INSERT draft row for stage; INSERT outdated rows downstream; UPDATE projects.updated_at
invalidates: downstream locked stages (outdated); Phase B scene locks are not touched
preserves: content copied for stage and downstream; version chain
ui_signal: Toast Stage n unlocked for editing; OUTDATED badge downstream

title: Scene stage lock (stage-locks/:n/lock)
summary: Locks scene stage 7 to 12 by writing locked with locked_at into scenes.stage_locks JSONB; requires previous stage locked (not outdated); stage 7 also sets shot_list_locked_at.
notes: Locking an already-locked stage is allowed and re-stamps locked_at.
trigger: stage completion in scene stage components or shell
precondition: project owned; scene in active branch; stage 7 or previous stage locked
side_effects: UPDATE scenes.stage_locks, updated_at; stage 7 sets shot_list_locked_at now (trigger sets status shot_list_ready when previously null)
ui_signal: Stage sidebar lock icon; completed stages list

title: Scene unlock assessment (409, no write)
summary: Unlock with confirm false computes downstream locked or outdated stages and frame and video counts, returning 409 impact details.
notes: videos table not defined in migrations; counts for videos may be 0 or query error (UNKNOWN). Frames count excludes status invalidated.

title: Scene unlock confirm (draft plus downstream outdated)
summary: Confirmed scene unlock sets the stage to draft, downstream locked or outdated stages to outdated, and for stage 7 clears shot_list_locked_at.
notes: Frames, videos, prompts are not modified. Cost numbers are informational.
side_effects: UPDATE scenes.stage_locks and updated_at; stage 7 clears shot_list_locked_at
ui_signal: Scene stage shows Edit state; downstream outdated

title: Scene stage relock (stage-locks/:n/relock)
summary: Outdated scene stage returns to locked without content change when the previous stage is locked.
notes: Stage 7 relock also sets shot_list_locked_at.
precondition: status outdated; previous stage locked (stage over 7)

title: Shot list lock and unlock sync stage 7 and downstream
summary: Shot list lock sets stage 7 locked; shot list unlock sets stage 7 draft and locked or outdated 8 to 12 to outdated; both also set or clear shot_list_locked_at, and the DB trigger syncs scenes.status.
notes: Second writer of the same JSON as sceneStageLocks routes; shot locking tests only check 401 and validation, not state transitions. Cross-slice Stage 7.
side_effects: UPDATE scenes stage_locks, shot_list_locked_at, updated_at; may insert invalidation_logs (table definition UNKNOWN)
preserves: frames and shots until explicit invalidation

title: Shot assignment change invalidates stages 9 to 12
summary: Changing shot-asset assignments marks any locked scene stage 9 to 12 as outdated in stage_locks.
notes: Cross-slice caller; this slice only owns the JSON shape.
preserves: draft and outdated values; stage 7 and 8 locks

title: Project creation and Main branch trigger
summary: POST /api/projects inserts a project with defaults (narrative, PG, 180 to 300 s); DB trigger creates Main branch and sets active_branch_id.
notes: Only Main branch is ever created; no application code creates branches.
side_effects: INSERT projects; trigger INSERT branches Main and UPDATE projects.active_branch_id

title: Project configuration update (PUT /api/projects/:id)
summary: Updates only supplied config columns with validation and always bumps updated_at; returns a recomputed currentStage.
notes: audio-visual value rejected (backend expects audio_visual). Title rename route exists but no UI calls it except Stage 1 config flow which does not send title. target_length_min floor 30 and max floor 60.

title: Project delete cascade
summary: DELETE /api/projects/:id deletes the project row; the database cascades to branches, stage_states and dependent tables (cascade targets beyond branches/stage_states are cross-slice).
notes: Storage objects not deleted by route; sessionStorage/localStorage project keys not cleared client-side. Route returns 204.
ui_signal: toast Project deleted and list reload

title: Scene defer and restore flag
summary: PUT defer sets scenes.is_deferred true and PUT restore sets it false; both are idempotent and touch only that flag.
notes: No other route consults is_deferred.

title: Continuity mode write
summary: PUT continuity-mode validates basic or advanced and updates projects.continuity_mode and updated_at.
notes: Default basic set by migration 040.

title: Frontend Phase A derivation (derivePhaseAStages and hydrate)
summary: On first load with stage_states present, latest row per stage 1 to 5 maps to locked, skipped, active, outdated or pending; currentStage is highest draft, else highest passed plus one (6 once all five passed).
notes: Invalidated and missing rows are pending. Hydration runs once per projectId and is skipped entirely when stage_states is empty. Three derivations exist (see V1-STATE-22).
precondition: projectId not new, not loading, stageStates non-empty, not yet hydrated
side_effects: sets stages state and currentStage; persistStage
preserves: restored stage if within allowed range

title: Frontend navigation guard
summary: For Phase A, a current stage that is pending or missing is redirected to the highest non-pending stage once hydrated; Phase B stages bypass the guard.
notes: Guard never runs when stage_states is empty.

title: Reached Phase B flag (localStorage)
summary: Once currentStage exceeds 5, project_<id>_reachedPhaseB is set to true, which keeps the Script Hub button visible in Phase A timeline.
notes: Browser-local only; not on server; never cleared.

title: Scene resume target derivation
summary: Entering a scene sets sceneStage to the first stage 7 to 12 whose lock is not locked or outdated (or 12 if all are), and completed to the locked or outdated list.
notes: Falls back to stage 7 on fetch error. Restore effect also refetches locks on every searchParams change, overwriting local completed.

title: Auto-save on mount rewrites stage rows
summary: Auto-save stages 2, 3 and 5 fire ~1 s after content is set from loaded state, writing a new version with status draft and origin NULL; this can demote a locked or outdated row (inferred from hook logic; runtime UNKNOWN).
notes: Hook skips only first render; content change from load triggers save. Settle by watching PUT stages/:n on opening a locked stage.
trigger: load of stage state on Phase A stage mount
side_effects: INSERT stage_states draft with origin NULL
invalidates: locked origin badges and outdated status

title: Backend project list and get currentStage derivation
summary: GET list computes currentStage as highest draft, else min(highest locked plus 1, 5), and stage badges from latest rows, ignoring skipped; GET by id uses all versions, not latest.
notes: Skipped and invalidated are pending in list, which contradicts ProjectView where skipped counts as passed.

title: Locked stage cannot regress to draft via save
summary: A PUT that requests draft on a stage whose latest version is locked is stored as locked.
notes: Only the draft case is guarded; outdated can be overwritten to draft by a save.
trigger: PUT stage save with status draft

title: Phase A lock predecessor rule
summary: Locking stage n greater than 1 requires latest n-1 locked or skipped; enforced in route and by DB trigger on any locked insert.
notes: Trigger reads latest version of predecessor by version desc.
trigger: lock or any insert with status locked

title: Skip eligibility
summary: Only stages 2 to 4 may be skipped; predecessor must be locked or skipped and the current latest must not be locked.
notes: Stage 5 never skipped.

title: Phase A unlock eligibility
summary: Phase A unlock requires latest stage 1 to 5 to be locked or skipped; outdated and draft are rejected with 400.
notes: Makes outdated Phase A stages un-editable; no relock route in stage_states.

title: Unlock cascades downstream to outdated
summary: Confirmed unlock of a stage marks every downstream stage whose latest is locked or outdated as outdated, in both Phase A and scene Phase B, without deleting content.
notes: Phase A cascade is per row insert, not transactional; partial failure possible.

title: Scene stage lock predecessor rule
summary: Scene stage n greater than 7 can lock only if n-1 is locked; outdated predecessors are rejected.
notes: Front end does not check; shell ignores lock failures.

title: Relock only from outdated
summary: Scene relock requires current status outdated and predecessor locked; other statuses return 400.

title: Stage 7 shot_list_locked_at is a mirror of stage_locks 7
summary: Stage 7 lock and unlock routes keep shot_list_locked_at in step with stage_locks.7 and rely on a DB trigger to set scenes.status.
notes: Two sources of truth for stage 7 lock.

title: Version uniqueness and read-then-insert race
summary: stage_states versions are computed by reading the latest row then inserting version+1; UNIQUE(branch_id, stage_number, version) makes a concurrent duplicate insert fail rather than duplicate.
notes: Two near-simultaneous saves from autosave and a lock can make one fail with 500.

title: scene stage_locks is a read-modify-write JSON map with no version guard
summary: All scene lock writers read scenes.stage_locks, mutate in memory and write the whole map back; concurrent writers can lose updates.
notes: Race window not tested.

title: Project ownership check on every slice route
summary: Every slice route resolves the project with eq id and eq user_id from the verified token before any child read or write.
notes: Scene routes check project then query scene by branch id; the scene is not checked against project directly beyond active_branch_id match.

title: Deferred scenes not enforced by backend
summary: is_deferred is only consulted by the Script Hub UI; stage-lock, shot, frame and generation routes do not check it.
notes: Checked by grep across slice route files only.

title: UI gating is not enforced by URL or routes
summary: Scene and Phase B stages open by any URL with stage and sceneId; Phase A stage 1 to 5 guard applies only after hydration with stage_states present.
notes: e2e tests rely on this (?stage=7 and ?stage=8 deep links).

title: Lock and unlock writes origin NULL
summary: Lock and unlock inserts never carry origin, so IMPORTED and AUTO-FILLED provenance is lost on the next version created by these paths; autosave also writes NULL origin.
notes: Save route copies origin only when request provides it.

title: Lock route does not bump projects.updated_at
summary: Phase A lock and unlock-assess routes do not touch projects.updated_at; save and skip and unlock-confirm do, so dashboard recency reflects only some writes.
notes: Dashboard ordering uses projects.updated_at, so a lock alone does not reorder projects.

title: Frontend has no direct table access
summary: All frontend data access goes through the Express API; the only Supabase calls are auth (getSession, signUp, signInWithPassword, signOut, onAuthStateChange) plus env var reads.
notes: Grep count of supabase.from/storage/rpc/channel in src (excluding tests) is 0.

title: Backend uses the service-role key and bypasses RLS
summary: backend/src/config/supabase.ts creates the only backend client with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; RLS policies in migration 001 are not exercised by the API.
notes: Authorization is enforced only by app-level user_id filters.

title: Main branch is created only by DB trigger
summary: No application code creates branches; the on_project_created trigger inserts Main and sets active_branch_id.
notes: Branch read by GET embed; branch switching absent.

title: Stages 4 and 5 double-lock
summary: Stage 4 and Stage 5 components call stageStateService.lockStage themselves, then the shell calls it again through handleStageComplete, creating two locked versions.
notes: Also applies to scene stages 8 to 10 and 12 (shell lock).

title: Phase A UnlockWarningDialog cannot open
summary: ProjectView reads result.downstreamStages from a 409 whose data sits under details, so the dialog branch is never taken and the unlock auto-confirms.
notes: Dialog is wired and works for Phase B scene stages.

title: Project type value mismatch
summary: Frontend option and type use audio-visual, backend validation and DB CHECK use audio_visual, so that option always fails validation.

title: Branch name fallback to main
summary: Project responses read branches?.[0]?.name from a to-one embed; the UI therefore shows the fallback main regardless of DB name Main (UNKNOWN until runtime).
notes: Settle by logging embed shape.

title: projects/new path is broken for lock
summary: The /projects/new path creates a project through Stage 1 but then locks stage 1 with the literal id new, which returns 404.
notes: Code-path finding; runtime not executed.

title: ProtectedRoute return path unused
